cases.disease: RPGRIP1-related retinal dystrophy (Leber congenital amaurosis / early-onset retinal dystrophy)
cases.mechanism_detail: A paternally inherited ~400-bp AluY with an 18-bp TSD inserted in RPGRIP1 exon 7 (null allele), in trans with maternal c.1363del frameshift in patient EYE345. RNA effect not studied.
cases.quote: De novo assembly and breakpoint PCR confirmed an approximate 400 bp AluY insertion with an 18 bp target site duplication (Figure 3b,c), suggesting that transposition occurred via LINE-1.
